storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: In a speech at the United Nations General Assembly, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian declared that Iran would not surrender following US President Donald Trump's threat to 'annihilate' the Islamic Republic. Pezeshkian characterized Iran as a victim of US terrorism, showcasing images of Iranian civilians affected by military actions. His address came amid ongoing conflict between Iran and the US and Israel.
